description: Update the OpenAI integration to properly detect which models require the Responses API instead of the Completions API. This should cover all GPT-5 Pro model families and all Codex models, using prefix matching to include dated snapshots. The detection logic should align with OpenAI's official documentation about which models are Responses API only.
functional_requirements: Update the model detection function to recognize all GPT-5 Pro model families (gpt-5-pro, gpt-5.2-pro, gpt-5.4-pro) as Responses API only
Update the model detection function to recognize all Codex models as Responses API only
Implement prefix matching logic so that dated model snapshots (e.g., gpt-5.4-pro-2026-03-05) are also correctly identified
